reignrender.config.disable.comment.disab: When enabled, particles will not be rendered
When enabled, entities will not be rendered
When enabled, blocks will not be rendered (fluids exempted)
When enabled, water and lava will not be rendered
When enabled, block entities like chests will not be rendered
When enabled, falling blocks like sand and gravel will not be rendered
When enabled, armor on players and mobs will not be rendered
When enabled, the item held in a player's or mob's hand will not be rendered
When enabled, the elytra equipped on players and mobs will not be rendered
When enabled, fog effects will not be rendered
reignrender.config.disable.comment.hideS: When enabled, your own model will not be rendered (e.g. in third person view)
reignrender.config.disable.comment.hideO: When enabled, other players' models will not be rendered
reignrender.config.disable.comment.disab: When enabled, name tags above entities will not be rendered
When enabled, the sky will not be rendered (overworld sky, sun/moon/stars, end void sky)
When enabled, clouds will not be rendered
When enabled, rain/snow precipitation and its sounds will not be rendered
When enabled, item entities (dropped items) will not be rendered. Note this is independent from Disable Entities
When enabled, HUD elements listed in Hidden HUD Elements are hidden one by one; an empty list hides nothing
When enabled, the black outline around the block you are looking at will not be rendered
When enabled, the enchantment glint effect on items will not be rendered (both in the inventory and in the world)
reignrender.config.generic.comment.enabl: Master switch for the face-mod (texture modification) feature. When on, the things whose ids are listed in the Face Mod tab render with the edited textures; when off, the generated resource pack is disabled again and everything renders with the original look
reignrender.config.generic.comment.keepS: When block entities are disabled, keep sign text visible
reignrender.config.generic.comment.revea: Release: holding the hotkey temporarily bypasses every render filter (including blocks and fluids); releasing restores filtering. Enable: holding the hotkey temporarily hides everything; releasing restores normal rendering. Only the categories checked in Hotkey Affected Types are affected

Render categories the reveal hotkey can affect. Only the categories checked here are bypassed (Release mode) or force-hidden (Enable mode) while the hotkey is held; the filters of unchecked categories stay unaffected
reignrender.config.generic.comment.repla: Master switch of the universal render replacement system. When enabled, every 'source=target' entry in the replacement lists renders the source id as the target id
reignrender.config.generic.comment.filte: How the filter lists are edited. View Selection opens the picker GUI to check ids; Manual Input opens a text box where multiple ids are separated by an English semicolon ;
reignrender.config.generic.comment.coord: How the Pick Coordinate hotkey selects positions. Single: the looked-at block position is stored directly; Box: the first press records corner 1 and the second press stores the whole region between both corners
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.openC: Opens the ReignRender in-game config GUI (default: X+R)
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.revea: Behavior while held (default: H) is controlled by the Hotkey Mode option: Release temporarily bypasses every render filter (entities, blocks, fluids, block entities, particles, armor, fog, name tags, players); Enable temporarily hides everything. Only the categories checked in Hotkey Affected Types are affected. Releasing restores normal rendering
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.pickE: Press while looking at an entity, particle, fluid or block to add (or remove) it from the matching filter list, without opening the config GUI. While sneaking, pressing picks the biome you are currently in and adds (or removes) it from the fog filter list
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.toggl: Master switch of the hide action. When on, the condition entries with the hide action apply: matching objects inside the region are hidden (without ids the whole region is hidden). Independent of the per-category rendering switches and applies in every dimension

Master switch of the replace action. When on, the condition entries with replace rules apply inside their regions, taking precedence over the global per-category replacement lists. Mutually exclusive with the Replacement Master Switch: while the global replacement is on the condition replacement does not apply, turning the global one off lets the conditions take over

Master switch of the face action. When on, the objects (blocks/falling blocks, entities, particles, items) matching the face condition entries render with the textures edited for those conditions. Mutually exclusive with the global face mod: while the global face mod is on the condition face mod does not apply, turning the global one off lets the conditions take over
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.pickC: Press while looking at a block to write its position into the condition list (creating a condition entry with a region and the hide action). In Single mode the looked-at position is picked directly; in Box mode the first press records corner 1 and the second press stores the whole region between both corners. Ids and actions can be attached in the condition editor
reignrender.config.hotkeys.comment.toggl: Master switch of the count conditions. When on, the count conditions of the condition entries cap how many matching objects are rendered per frame (entities, particles, block entities) / baked per section (blocks). Independent of the per-category filters: the caps apply even when the matching filter is off

Master switch of the distance conditions. When on, the distance conditions of the condition entries hide matching objects farther from the camera than the cap (in blocks). Independent of the per-category filters: the limits apply even when the matching filter is off

reignrender.config.filter.comment.entity: How the entity list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.blockM: How the block list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.fluidM: How the fluid list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.blockE: How the block entity list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.partic: How the particle list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.armorM: How the armor list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.fogMod: How the fog list is applied. Off disables filtering, Blacklist hides the listed ids, Whitelist only shows the listed ids
reignrender.config.conditions.comment.co: Unified condition system, one entry per line, in the format region=box;dist=N;count=N;ids=id1,id2;acts=actions. The region is 'x,y,z' or 'x1,y1,z1~x2,y2,z2'; dist is the max distance from the camera in blocks; count is the per frame / per section render cap; ids are the affected objects (blocks, entities, particles, fluids, items - the category is resolved from the registries, ids resolving to nothing match name tags / player names as text); acts are the actions: hide (hide the whole region), blacklist (hide the listed ids inside the region), keep (whitelist - only the listed ids stay visible inside the region), face, replace:source=target (multiple allowed). Blacklist and whitelist are mutually exclusive; new entries default to blacklist. Region actions require region; dist/count require ids; hide without ids hides the whole region. Click the button to open the condition editor
reignrender.config.filter.comment.filter: Entity type ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:creeper;minecraft:zombie. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Block ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:stone;minecraft:dirt. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Fluid ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:water;minecraft:lava. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Block entity type ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:chest;minecraft:furnace. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Particle type ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:flame;minecraft:heart. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Armor item ids hidden or kept by the filter. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;, e.g. minecraft:diamond_helmet;minecraft:iron_chestplate. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids

Fog identities hidden or kept by the filter: fog type ids (water, lava, powder_snow, atmospheric), biome ids (e.g. minecraft:swamp), dimension ids (e.g. minecraft:overworld) or effect fog ids (effect:blindness, effect:darkness, effect:wither, effect:night_vision, effect:pumpkin). The list starts empty; the reset button clears it. In Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids
reignrender.config.filter.comment.nameTa: How the name tag list is applied while Disable Name Tags is on. Off hides every name tag, Blacklist hides the listed names, Whitelist only shows the listed names
reignrender.config.filter.comment.player: How the player list is applied while Hide Other Players is on. Off hides every other player, Blacklist hides the listed players, Whitelist only shows the listed players
reignrender.config.filter.comment.filter: Player names whose name tags are hidden or kept, separated by semicolons, e.g. 123;234. Matched case-insensitively
Player names that are hidden or kept, separated by semicolons, e.g. wdylyh12. Matched case-insensitively
reignrender.config.filter.comment.hidden: HUD element ids hidden while Disable HUD Elements is on. In View Selection mode, click the button to open the picker GUI and check ids; in Manual Input mode, separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ;. Available ids: bossbar, subtitles, chat, statusEffects, crosshair, hotbar, overlayMessage, title, scoreboard, playerList, demoTimer, heldItemTooltip, fire, nausea, vignette
reignrender.config.filter.comment.replac: Particle render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:flame=minecraft:heart. The source particle renders as the target particle
Block render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:stone=minecraft:diamond_block. The source block renders as the target block (chunk meshes are rebuilt automatically)
Entity render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:zombie=minecraft:skeleton. The source entity renders as the target entity (visual only, the entity itself is unchanged)

Fog render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line. Sources can be fog types (water, lava, powder_snow, atmospheric), biome ids or dimension ids, e.g. minecraft:swamp=minecraft:desert turns swamp fog into desert fog
Armor render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:iron_helmet=minecraft:diamond_helmet. The source armor renders as the target armor
Name tag text replacement entries, one 'source name=target name' per line. Names are matched case-insensitively, e.g. Notch=Herobrine renders the name tag of a Notch entity as Herobrine
Player name replacement entries, one 'source name=target name' per line. Names are matched case-insensitively, e.g. wdylyh12=Steve
Fluid render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:water=minecraft:lava. The source fluid renders as the target fluid (chunk meshes are rebuilt automatically)

Block entity render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, source being a block id (e.g. minecraft:chest), e.g. minecraft:chest=minecraft:barrel. The source block entity renders as the target block entity
Falling block render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:sand=minecraft:gravel. A falling source block renders as the target block
Item drop (ItemEntity) render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:porkchop=minecraft:slime_ball. A dropped source item renders as the target item

Held item (third person hand) render replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. minecraft:iron_sword=minecraft:diamond_sword. The source item held by an entity (including other players) renders as the target item

HUD element replacement entries, one 'source=target' per line, e.g. hotbar=bossbar. The source HUD element no longer renders; the target element renders in its place (bossbar/subtitles/chat/statusEffects/crosshair/hotbar/overlayMessage/title/scoreboard/playerList/demoTimer/heldItemTooltip/nausea/vignette)
reignrender.config.face.comment.facePart: Particle type ids for texture modification. After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, all particles of that id render with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceEnti: Entity type ids for texture modification. After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, all entities of that id render with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceBloc: Block ids for texture modification. After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, all blocks of that id render with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceFlui: Fluid ids for texture modification. After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, all fluids of that id render with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceBloc: Block ids for block entity texture modification (e.g. minecraft:chest). After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, those block entities render with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceFall: Block ids for falling-state texture modification (e.g. minecraft:sand). Textures edited for a listed id only apply while the block is falling (shadow textures); once it lands the original texture renders. Listed ids automatically use their shadow textures, identical to the originals until edited. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceHeld: Item ids for held-state texture modification (e.g. minecraft:diamond). Textures edited for a listed id only apply while the item is held (shadow textures); drops and the GUI keep the original look. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceItem: Item ids for dropped-item texture modification (e.g. minecraft:diamond). Textures edited for a listed id only apply while the item is a dropped entity (shadow textures); held items and the GUI keep the original look. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceArmo: Armor item ids for texture modification. After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, wearing that armor renders with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceElyt: Elytra texture modification, the id is fixed to minecraft:elytra. After adding it, edit the textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, the elytra renders with the edited textures
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceSky: Sky texture (sun, moon) modification, the id is fixed to minecraft:sky. After adding it, edit the textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, the sky renders with the edited textures
reignrender.config.face.comment.faceHudE: HUD element ids for texture modification (e.g. hotbar, crosshair). After adding an id, edit its textures one by one in the texture list; once saved, that HUD element renders with the edited textures. Separate multiple ids with an English semicolon ; in Manual Input mode
